item.title: Raspberry pi
item.description:
After hearing frequent mentions of Raspberry pi use cases, I had decided to buy Raspberry pi 4 model.

The site https://www.thingbits.in was giving best discounts on pi and it’s accessories.

The best use case of pi was the implementation of PI-HOLE which blocks all the ads on websites.

Here are links i used for the complete installation of pi and implementation of PI-HOLE

https://docs.pi-hole.net/

https://medium.com/swlh/how-to-set-up-pi-hole-2293246dc8ed

https://filterlists.com/lists/pl-host-file
